cli.description: Telegram media downloader with a web management UI
cli.opt.lang: Language for CLI messages (en or zh-TW)
cli.opt.home: Project directory containing .env, data/ and logs/ (default: current directory)
cli.opt.chat: Chat to download from: numeric id, @username or t.me link
cli.opt.limit: Number of most recent messages to scan
cli.cmd.set_password: Set the web admin username and password
cli.cmd.serve: Start web UI, monitors and download workers (Ctrl+C to stop)
cli.cmd.fetch: One-shot: download media from the latest messages of a chat
cli.login.phone_invalid: Invalid phone number, please try again.
cli.login.code_invalid: Invalid or expired code, please try again.
cli.not_logged_in: Not logged in to Telegram. Run `tgdl login` first.
cli.password.prompt: New web admin password (at least {min} characters):
cli.password.too_short: Password must be at least {min} characters.
cli.password.done: Web admin account "{username}" saved. All existing web sessions were signed out.
config.missing_api: API_ID and API_HASH must be set in .env (see .env.example).
config.bad_api_id: API_ID in .env must be a number.
config.bad_port: WEB_PORT in .env must be a number.
config.base_dir_not_absolute: ALLOWED_BASE_DIRS entry must be an absolute path: {path}
template.base_dir_position: {base_dir} may only appear at the start of the template.
template.bad_segment: Template contains an empty, '.' or '..' path segment.
template.needs_filename: The last path segment must contain {filename}.
dir.not_absolute: Directory must be an absolute path.
dir.outside_allowed: Directory is outside the allowed base directories.
cli.cmd.monitor: Manage chat monitors (list / add / remove / enable / disable)
cli.monitor.need_id: Please use the numeric chat id (see `tgdl monitor list`).
cli.monitor.done: Done. A running `tgdl serve` applies this within 30 seconds.
cli.serve.started: Running as {name}: {monitors} active monitor(s), {concurrency} worker(s). Press Ctrl+C to stop.
cli.serve.stopping: Stopping... (press Ctrl+C again to force quit)
backfill.bad_range: The start date must not be after the end date.
backfill.already_running: A backfill is already running for this chat.
backfill.not_monitored: Add the chat as a monitor before running a backfill.
app.name: Telegram Downloader
cli.serve.web_url: Web UI: {url} (use an SSH tunnel for remote access)
cli.serve.no_password: Warning: the web admin account is not set up. Run `tgdl set-password`.
login.title: Sign in
login.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} minute(s).
login.expired: The login form expired. Please try again.
flood.title: Telegram rate limit (FloodWait)
dash.workers_paused: All workers are paused because of FloodWait.
monitors.none: No chats are monitored yet. Add one below.
monitors.confirm_remove: Stop monitoring "{chat}"? Downloaded files and history are kept.
monitors.dialogs_flood: Telegram rate limit: the chat list cannot be loaded right now.
monitors.dialogs_failed: Could not load the chat list. Check the Telegram connection.
monitor.keyword_hint: Only download files whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).
monitor.min_gt_max: Min size must not exceed max size.
monitor.no_types: Select at least one media type, or use the global default.
settings.concurrency_hint: 1–10. Applied immediately; running downloads are not interrupted.
settings.template_vars: Must start with {base_dir}/ and end with a segment containing {filename}. Variables:
settings.category_order: Order: Telegram media type first, then file extension, then MIME type; otherwise Others. Split archive parts (.7z.001, .zip.002, .z01, .r00) use the category of their archive format (7z, zip, rar), so no extra entries are needed.
settings.mime_hint: One rule per line: image/ = Photos (longest prefix wins)
settings.language_hint: Used when a browser has not chosen a language.
settings.bad_mime_line: Each MIME rule must look like: prefix = Category
settings.category_map_duplicate_extensio: Extension is assigned to more than one category:
flash.chat_not_found: Chat not found in your chat list. Reload the list and try again.
flash.bad_range: The start date must not be after the end date.
flash.already_running: A backfill is already running for this chat.
flash.not_monitored: Add the chat as a monitor first.
dash.workers_pausing: Downloads already in progress will finish; workers then pause until the FloodWait ends.
history.confirm_retry_all: Put all failed downloads back in the queue?
history.confirm_missing: Check every downloaded file and queue those missing on disk?
history.bad_range: The start date must not be after the end date.
logs.english_note: Newest first. Log files are always written in English.
flash.job_requeued: The download was put back in the queue.
flash.jobs_requeued: {n} failed download(s) put back in the queue.
flash.job_skipped: Skipped: this file is already downloaded or queued.
flash.job_not_failed: That download is not in the failed state.
flash.file_exists: The file still exists; nothing to do.
cli.serve.all_interfaces: Listening on all interfaces: open http://SERVER-IP:{port}/ (IP addresses always work). Host names allowed: {hosts}. Add other names to ALLOWED_HOSTS in .env.
settings.resume_hint: When tgdl is stopped, crashes, or hits a network error or FloodWait, unfinished .part files are kept and continued later (the last 512 KB is fetched again). Photos and files of unknown size always restart. Turned off: unfinished files are deleted and downloaded again from the start.
login.no_account: The web admin account is not set up yet. Run `tgdl set-password` on the server (it now also asks for a username).
cli.password.bad_username: Invalid username: 1–64 characters, letters, digits and . _ @ + - only.
